items.title: 6.11.1 Entropy, diffusion and the number of ways of arrangement (arrangement ke tareeqe) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.11.1, printed page 136.

blocks.text: Vapour (bhaap) ke molecules chance (ittefaq) se diffuse hote (phailte) hain. Yeh samajhne ke liye sochiye ke kisi ek waqt par un sab ke ek hi jagah milne ki probability (imkan) kitna hai. Figure 6.10 ka saada model dekhiye.

blocks.alt: Do horizontal gas jars end to end jure hain aur beech mein partition hai. Baen gas jar A mein teen molecules hain jin par 1, 2 aur 3 likha hai; daen gas jar B khali hai. Labels: partition, gas jar A, gas jar B.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.10: Diffusion aur possible arrangements ki tadaad (kitab ki Figure 6.10 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jar A mein teen molecules (1, 2, 3) hain aur jar B khali hai; beech mein partition (deewar) hai. Partition hatane par har molecule A ya B kisi mein bhi ja sakta hai.
Jar A se jar B mein diffusion ke baad yeh molecules do jars mein 8 alag alag tareeqon se arrange ho sakte hain.
Isi tarah agar shuru mein jar A mein 5 molecules hon to arrangements 2⁵ = 32 hongi. Aur 100 molecules hon to 2¹⁰⁰. Aam formula xʸ hai, jahan x jagahon ki tadaad aur y particles ki tadaad hai.

Diffusion is liye hoti hai ke molecules ko arrange karne ke tareeqe bohat zyada hain. Particles ya un ki energy ke arrangement ke ‘tareeqon ki tadaad’ se andaza hota hai ke koi process ho sakta hai ya nahi.

blocks.prompt: Jar A mein gas ke 100 molecules hain jo khali jar B se jura hai. Stopcock kholne par kitni arrangements possible hain, aur gas khud se wapas jar A mein kyun nahi aati?
blocks.explanation: 2¹⁰⁰ arrangements, kyun ke har molecule do mein se kisi bhi jar mein ho sakta hai. In mein sirf ek arrangement aisa hai jis mein saare 100 molecules A mein hon, is liye un ka khud wapas A mein jama hona taqreeban impossible hai.

items: Tarteebon ki tadaad = xʸ (x jagahen, y particles): 3 molecules, 2 jars = 2³ = 8; 5 molecules = 32; 100 molecules = 2¹⁰⁰.
Diffusion is liye hoti hai ke phaili hui arrangements bohat zyada hain.
